# Labs for this section

No classroom RAG or agents labs are written yet. When they appear they will be step-by-step wiki pages, in the same spirit as the labs on [albertprofe.dev](https://albertprofe.dev){.external target="_blank"}. The exact numbering is still open.

**Lab#RAG001** is an annotated external write-up of a multi-agent trading setup from January 2025. It is not the first classroom lab I intend to write here.
